candidates.title: Goblet Thrusters #kettlebell #kettlebellworkout #kettlebellkings #strengthtraining
candidates.description:
Secure bell into a goblet grip (aka horn grip) almost even with chin

Keep feet slightly angles outward and just outside of shoulder width

Deep inhale. Corkscrew feet/knees outward as you slowly descend.

Travel just below 90 degrees. 

Then exhale as you drive feet through the ground to stand tall and press the bell at the top
